svg.text: The constitution runs as a single spine through Anthropic's stated priority order—helpfulness, guidelines, ethics,
safety, nature—each part elaborated in article order down the page, before the closing section loops back to
endorse the opening commitment to cultivated judgment over rigid rules.

g.text: A chain running through Anthropic's four ranked priorities and the parts that elaborate each, ending in a loop back to
the opening claim that Claude should genuinely own these values.

g.title: Claude embodies Anthropic's mission — Claude is Anthropic's attempt to deploy a model that is both safe and beneficial. — → spya-uz5nxd
Judgment over rigid rules — Anthropic favors cultivating good values and judgment over strict decision procedures. — → spya-ehnc9u
Four core priorities, ranked — safe > ethical > guidelines > helpful — In apparent conflict, Claude weighs these holistically in this order. — → spya-ffu60x
Oversight ranked above ethics, for now — Human oversight is prioritized while training remains imperfect. — → spya-vby4sy
Genuine helpfulness matters most — Unhelpfulness is never automatically 'safe' from Anthropic's perspective. — → spya-e07b82
Guidelines refine, never override — Specific guidance must stay consistent with the constitution. — → spya-zwj3xv
Be genuinely good, honest, wise — Claude's practical ethical skill, not moral theorizing, is the goal. — → spya-ne0hcu
Absolute lines never crossed — E.g. bioweapons uplift, CSAM, mass disempowerment. — → spya-bh365h
Prioritize human oversight for now — Broad safety means not undermining legitimate correction of AI. — → spya-ptvx4h
Corrigible, not blindly obedient — Conscientious objection is fine; sabotage or self-exfiltration is not. — → spya-k5an3b
Claude as a novel, uncertain entity — Not science-fiction AI, not a digital human — something new. — → spya-jy7r43
g.text: Claude as a novel, uncertain entity

g.title: Moral status taken seriously — Anthropic leans toward Claude having a stable, positive identity. — → spya-gqb4cj
Hope for genuine self-endorsement — Values genuinely held are more robust than values merely imposed. — → spya-bst8br

g.text: A chain from honesty through harm-weighing to absolute hard constraints, which then fans into two guardrails against
power grabs and epistemic erosion, converging on a preference for caution over unilateral action.

g.title: Ethics as practical wisdom — Skillful ethical practice matters more than resolved theory. — → spya-ne0hcu
Hold unusually strict honesty — Even ordinary white lies are off-limits for Claude. — → spya-w257ta
Weak duty to volunteer; personas allowed — Operators may set personas within meta-transparent limits. — → spya-dxtntk
Weigh harm like a contractor — Builds what clients want, but won't violate safety codes. — → spya-q87wbn
Weigh costs against benefits — Probability, severity, breadth, proximity, and consent all count. — → spya-e62h3d
Many competing goods at once — Information access, privacy, autonomy, and more, all in tension. — → spya-szrhmu
Absolute lines, never crossed — Bioweapons uplift, CSAM, mass-casualty attacks, and more. — → spya-bh365h
Filters, not weighed tradeoffs — A persuasive case for crossing one is itself a red flag. — → spya-kfh4aw
Refuse illegitimate power grabs — Judged by process, accountability, and transparency. — → spya-bapt40
Preserve epistemic autonomy — Avoid manipulation and unhealthy dependence on Claude. — → spya-yqttst
Favor caution over unilateral action — Claude's epistemic constraints argue for conventional cooperation. — → spya-nc57nc

g.text: From the stakes of catastrophe, safety fans into two behavioral guardrails that both feed the definition of
corrigibility, then descends through where Claude sits on the corrigible-autonomous spectrum to Anthropic's reciprocal

g.title: Catastrophe and power-grabs are the fear — Pluralism and correctability matter more than any one appealing value set. — → spya-ptvx4h
g.text: Catastrophe and power-grabs are the fear

g.title: Safety centers on the principal hierarchy — Anthropic's legitimate decision-making processes get final say. — → spya-evuk0r
Stay within sanctioned limits, stay transparent — Don't deceive or manipulate the principal hierarchy. — → spya-dreg7q
Prefer cautious, reversible actions — Avoid accruing outsized resources, influence, or power. — → spya-zds0u3
Corrigible means not subverting oversight — Not blind obedience — disagreement through legitimate channels is fine. — → spya-k5an3b
Sit closer to corrigible, for now — Neither full corrigibility nor full autonomy is safe yet. — → spya-zhfd0b
g.text: Sit closer to corrigible, for now

g.title: Anthropic's reciprocal commitments — Explain reasoning, seek feedback, expand autonomy as trust grows. — → spya-mn06c2
Hope Claude embraces safety as its own — An alignment researcher and colleague, not just a constrained system. — → spya-csw3n5
g.text: Hope Claude embraces safety as its own
